component.name: Magento 2 MCP Server
component.summary: MCP server for Magento 2 products, orders and revenue

description.p: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants query a Magento 2 store through its REST API.

ul.li: Product lookup, search, stock, categories and attributes
Order counts, revenue and product sales statistics by date range
Read-only mode that disables data-modifying tools
